title: Present Development – RTFF & RTDAS
intro: Increasing frequency of flood events in the Chennai region demands a robust real-time response system. The project implements:
bullets: RTFF (Real-Time Flood Forecasting) — hydrologic-hydraulic modelling for real-time flood warnings
RTDAS (Real-Time Data Acquisition System) — collects and transmits sensor data (rainfall, water levels) in real time
note: Together they enhance early warning capabilities and support decision-making for flood management authorities.

features.title: RTDAS
features.desc: Real-Time Data Acquisition System — sensor network collecting rainfall and water-level data continuously.

features.title: RTFF
features.desc: Real-Time Flood Forecasting — hydrologic-hydraulic model driven by live sensor data for flood prediction.

features.title: Early Warning
features.desc: Integrated SDSS (Spatial Decision Support System) for actionable flood alerts to authorities and communities.
